groups.title: Federated Identity Architecture
groups.question: Explain how you would give people a single identity that works across AWS, Azure and GCP.

followUps.SAML and OIDC Federation Across Clouds: How do you map identity provider groups to cloud roles, and why would you pick OIDC over SAML for some cases?
followUps.GCP Workforce Identity Federation: What problem does GCP Workforce Identity Federation solve compared to creating separate GCP user accounts?

groups.title: Secrets Management
groups.question: Walk through how you would handle secrets and security audit data across several clouds.

followUps.HashiCorp Vault as Multi-Cloud Secrets P: Why are dynamic, short-lived secrets from Vault safer than long-lived keys stored with the application?
followUps.Cross-Cloud Audit Logging and SIEM Integ: Why can an attack that moves across clouds stay hidden when each cloud keeps its own audit logs?

groups.title: Zero Trust in Multi-Cloud
groups.question: Explain what zero trust means when services on different clouds need to talk to each other.

followUps.Workload Identity and Service-to-Service: How does workload identity with something like SPIFFE replace shared API keys or IP allowlists?
followUps.Multi-Cloud IAM Governance with Brainwav: Why do manual access reviews stop working as a multi-cloud estate grows, and what does a governance tool add?

groups.title: RBAC Consistency Across Clouds
groups.question: Explain how you would keep access control consistent when every cloud has different roles and permissions.

followUps.Designing Cloud-Agnostic Permission Tier: Why is it tempting to grant broad built-in roles on each cloud, and how do permission tiers fix that?
followUps.Privileged Access Management Across Clou: How does just-in-time privileged access reduce risk, and why centralize those requests across clouds?
